C1060.title: Three Arrested for Illegally Setting Up GOIP Devices
C1060.summary: In July 2025, police in Ningyuan, Hunan investigated a case in which GOIP devices were used to relay fraud calls and send scam messages for fraudsters. Police first arrested Chen Moujun and seized four phone cards, then arrested Zhou Mouwen and Yuan Mouxiang while they were operating GOIP equipment in a county hotel room. The three were placed under criminal coercive measures on suspicion of aiding information network criminal activity, and the case remained under further investigation.
